verdict.rationale: Ironclad explicitly markets a searchable repository ('Store Contracts Securely, Find Them Easily') and offers AI-based contract intelligence for extracting terms, plus APIs to read/retrieve structured contract data. However, the evidence pack lacks concrete detail on metadata extraction accuracy, search functionality specifics, or independent validation of these repository/search claims. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of search and key-term extraction quality, detail on metadata schema/extraction mechanics, and third-party corroboration beyond marketing pages.
